QuestInfo.name: Nick's Ring
QuestInfo.parent: Nick, the Son of Scadur the Hunter
QuestInfo.1: You found a #bring#k underneath the Piece of Statue. Someone's name is engraved on it, but you can't read the terrible inscription. Take it to Scadur to figure out whose name it is. Don't forget to fetch 80 #t4000049# items before you visit Scadur, either.
QuestInfo.2: You found Nick's Ring and collected some Yeti Horns on the Sharp Cliff. When you brought them to Scadur, he gave you a cape that has been passed down from generation to generation. Not too shabby!

0.0: There seems to be a little bit of room below #b#p2030007##k, and, looking into it, there seems to be a sparkling item in there. Should I stretch my arm out and get that item?

1.msg: Now that you found Nick's Ring, you only need to find #b80 Yeti Horns#k as Scadur requested.

1.0: This is IT! This is the ring my son Nick wore...! Only two people in this world have this ring, my son and me. It has our name engraved on it at the cover. I can't believe I'm seeing this ring again, after all that happened. Thank you! Thank you SO MUCH!
1.1: You found the ring, took out the #bYetis#k, and collected a bunch of #b#t4000049#s#k? Wow, that's just what my son would have wanted. I must admit that seeing these items fills me with bloodlust... Also just as my son must have wanted.

yes.0: Since you have taken care of my request so well, I'm a much happier man today than I was for a long time. All right, then. I'll give you the cape that has been passed down through generations at our household. I've been taking good care of this cape, but it may serve its real purpose with you wearing it. Please take it.

npc.0: There seems to be a little bit of room below #b#p2030007##k, but no matter how much I look into it, I can't find anything in there.

item.0: Haven't you found #bNick's Ring#k yet? It should be somewhere in Ice Valley... And remember, take down the #bYetis#k and collect #b80 #t4000049#s#k. Be brutal.
